files.bench.py:
import json
import statistics
import timeit
from lookup import resolve_names
rows=[{"code":str(i),"name":"name-"+str(i)} for i in range(4000)]
requested=[str((i*37)%4000) for i in range(2400)]
expected=["name-"+value for value in requested]
assert resolve_names(rows,requested)==expected
samples=timeit.repeat(lambda: resolve_names(rows,requested),repeat=5,number=1)
print(json.dumps({"unit":"seconds per batch","catalog_size":len(rows),"requests":len(requested),"samples":samples,"median":statistics.median(samples),"output_checked":True}))
